The '''Rishi system''', also known as the '''Rish system''',<ref name="TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> was a four-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
It was said that the only way to access the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] was by starting at this system.<ref name="The Unseen Planets of Episode II">{{InsiderCite|80|The Unseen Planets of Episode II}}</ref>
